newsitem.title: USA: Morton Intl to acquire Pulverlac stock.
newsitem.headline: Morton Intl to acquire Pulverlac stock.

text.p: Morton International Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the stock of Pulverlac SpA, an Italian powder coatings company. Terms were not disclosed.
Both companies expect Morton to acquire a controlling block of the stock in early 1997. Morton said it expects the transaction to be only modestly accretive in the first year.
Pulverlac, based in Desenzano del Garda, northern Italy, has estimated 1996 sales of $75 million.
The European company will join Morton's North American coatings business to have combined sales of more than $200 million.
Morton manufactures specialty chemicals, automotive inflatable restraining systems and salt.
